name: Unomaru Souichirou
source:
Hobbies: Observing the human condition
Likes: Cute things
Dislikes: Arguing

Souichirou is the director of Mitsurugi Agency Shin-Yokohama's seventh laboratory branch, and the one who gives direct orders to both [url=/c28595]Mei[/url] and [url=/c20281]Es[/url]. Eccentric and big-headed, Souichirou's real motives have always remained a mystery to everyone who knows him. After the loss of his parents, he developed a dangerous philosophy about humans and how they work, although few could tell because of his bizarre persona. He often introduces himself with an odd title, usually to do with being the 'patron Saint of children'. He is also a hypocrite of his own beliefs: while he states everything he does is for the sake of humanity, he shows a total lack of empathy for them.

[From [url=http://blazblue.wikia.com/wiki/S%C5%8Dichir%C5%8D_Unomaru]Blazblue Wiki[/url]]
